title: Continous analogue of Hirsch conjecture
exact_target: Is the worst-case turning of the primal central path at most a constant times the number of defining inequalities, uniformly in dimension?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3098 (OPG-610). CC BY 4.0.

Deza, Antoine; Terlaky, Tamas; Zinchenko, Yuriy, Continous analogue of Hirsch conjecture, Open Problem Garden, node 610. Complete problem, discussion and bibliography (including mathematical image alt text).

Xavier Allamigeon, Pascal Benchimol, Stéphane Gaubert and Michael Joswig, \emph{Long and winding central paths}, arXiv:1405.4161v3 (2017). Introduction; Section2.3 (log-barrier central path); Section5 (totalcurvature).
